heading: Tata Capital, Tata Power, and more: Tata stocks fall as Tata Trusts-Tata Sons battle intensifies - Check the latest
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: The dispute between Tata Trusts and Tata Sons intensifies as the Trusts challenge N Chandrasekaran’s reappointment, claiming it violates their voting rights. This could lead to legal action, while Tata Group stocks face pressure amidst the unfolding corporate governance issues.
